it makes no Marketcheck or other paid API call.\u0022,\u0022For each VIN it searches html.duckduckgo.com for the VIN, opens at most a few results on Copart or IAA archive sites (bid.cars and similar), and reads the auction, lot, sale date, sale document, primary and secondary damage, ACV, repair estimate, and odometer; it handles one VIN at a time with a pause between them.\u0022,\u0022Each VIN\\u0027s result (found with its fields, not found, or could not read with a reason such as a captcha or a changed page) is stored on the vehicle in the ledger with a checked-at stamp, and is re-checked only after seven days or after a could-not-read result; a captcha or block is recorded as could not read and the run moves on, never retrying in a loop.\u0022,\u0022A found auction sale raises a \\u0027salvage-auction\\u0027 red flag naming the sale document, damage, and date (for example \\u0027sold at salvage auction (Salvage certificate (CA), Side/Front end, 2026-07-16)\\u0027); odo show prints the stored auction record, and rank shows the flag with the other red flags.\u0022,\u0022Tests cover the field extraction from recorded or modeled archive-page fixtures for JTDBCMFEXS3070309, a not-found search, and a captcha page; a new docs page (or a section of docs/research.md) describes the command and says archive sites change and may block automated reads.\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Feature\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Approved by Brian 2026-10-03 in the run session. Motivating car: rank-4 JTDBCMFEXS3070309 (2025 Corolla Hybrid XLE, 17,289 dollars at Liz Auto Sales) was Copart lot 1-55637026 (San Martin CA, sold 2026-07-16, Salvage certificate (CA), primary damage Side, secondary Front end, ACV 23,937, repair estimate 22,579) while NICB VINCheck showed nothing and Marketcheck history showed only an Erepairables.com row. Evidence: notes/run-orchestrator-2026-10-03-journal.md (project home), 16:25 entry. Google served an unusual-traffic captcha; html.duckduckgo.com worked. Keep volume small. Paid NMVTIS (VinAudit and similar) is deferred and is the fallback if the archive sites block automated reads.
